summary: Pigmented diaphragm in front of the lens; radial fibres, crypts and collarette are procedural; colour comes from the subject's variant.

diameter.note: True iris diameter root to root; the outer ~0.3-0.5 mm sits hidden under the limbus, so the visible iris ends at the corneal diameter.

ruff_width.note: Pupillary ruff: posterior pigment epithelium wrapping round the pupil margin, seen as a dark beaded lip just outside the pupil.

limbal_ring_width.note: Apparent (through the cornea) width of the dark limbal ring, from its half-dark onset to the visible iris edge. Measured on source.jpg; thins with age.

limbal_ring_ramp.note: 10-90% width of the ring's inner onset (apparent mm). Render-calibrated on source.jpg.

limbal_blend_width.note: 10-90% width of the soft iris-to-sclera transition, centred on the corneal edge (apparent mm). Measured on source.jpg.

albedo_dark.note: Crypt floors and pupillary ruff: the posterior pigment epithelium seen through.

border_layer_albedo.note: Anterior border layer between the crypts in the crypt band just outside the collarette. Placeholder for the normal brown eye; subject colours come from the variant.

ciliary_albedo.note: Ciliary-zone stroma between the radial ridges; differs from the pupillary zone in hazel and two-tone irides.

trabecula_albedo.note: Crests of the radial trabeculae and the collarette ridge. Placeholder for the normal brown eye; subject colours come from the variant.

limbal_darkening.note: Luma factor on the iris at the floor of the limbal ring (peripheral pigment plus recess under the limbal overhang). Replaces the painted limbal_colour. Calibrated on source.jpg.

limbal_veil.note: Fraction of the sclera base colour scattered over the ring by the oblique limbal tissue; gives the cool grey cast at the edge. Calibrated on source.jpg.

limbal_texture_fade.note: Fraction of the iris texture contrast (fibres, mottling, crypts) kept at the floor of the limbal ring. Measured on gen-brown-01 (about half). Render calibration.

collarette_position.note: Radial position between pupil margin (0) and root (1).

collarette_dilated_scale.note: Width of the band from pupil margin to collarette in a dilated eye, against its width at that pupil size: the band gathers towards the margin as the pupil opens. Render-calibrated, not clinically validated.

collarette_edge_roughness.note: Collarette band outer edge: fine irregularity (noise amplitude, about 4 per tooth) added to the sawtooth teeth (lobes, amplitude, lobe_jitter). ridge_width is the band shoulder and the width of its soft shadow, ridge_height the band height.

collarette_crypt_count.note: Crypts of the collarette band, one candidate slot each, plus a half-size family between them; they sit along the band outer edge and inside it.

collarette_crypt_length.note: Median radial length of a collarette-band crypt as a fraction of the band width (pupil margin to collarette); width from crypts.aspect, spread from crypts.size_spread.

collarette_rim_brightness.note: Pale trabecular rim round the band crypts and along the band edge: blend toward trabecula_albedo.

collarette_net_angle.note: Fibre net across the band: the pupillary bundles plus two copies slanted by +/- this angle from radial, so the bundles cross.

convexity.note: Forward bowing of the pupillary portion riding on the lens; large values approach iris bombe.

provenance.source: Morphology and sizes (diameter, collarette, crypts, ruff, furrows): Bron, Tripathi & Tripathi, Wolff's Anatomy of the Eye and Orbit, 8th ed., ch. on the iris; Snell & Lemp, Clinical Anatomy of the Eye, 2nd ed. Limbal ring: Peshek et al., Evol Psychol 9:137 (2011). Ring, blend, colours, generator parameters and convexity: render calibration on assets/exterior/source.jpg (docs/realism/L4-iris-pupil.md). Fibre bundles, mottling, crypt size distribution and limbal texture fade: render calibration on the user reference assets/refs/iris/gen-brown-01.png (AI-generated), cross-checked on source.jpg (L4b refinement). Collarette band (teeth, band height and shoulder, edge roughness, band crypts, rim, fibre net): render calibration on a user reference cut-out of the pupillary-zone ring (L4c, structure only).
